name: Jelly Row
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Row is a free match-three game with a startling and strategic twist. Imagine a world filled with row upon row of Jiggling jelly monsters. One-eyed, two-eyed, three-eyed, covered in spikes and slime: this is the reality of Jelly Row. In Jelly Row you only have control over one singular row which you can move from left to right. All around you the monsters are multiplying and you need to slide it from here to there in order to line up three in a row before they are able to fill up the screen. You have to move fast but you also have to make sure those moves matter. If you aren't able to line the Jelly Row up with one of the columns before the column itself fills up from top to bottom, then you're going to lose the ability to manipulate that particular column. It is tragic but it is also kind of fair. The Jelly Monsters just want to hang out with their friends. In fact, maybe you're the bad guy for pushing them around and trying to make them explode into nothingness. Have you ever thought of it like that? Well, you should have. We thought of it like that.
